title: Mixed Event — Warmth in Every Stitch

meta.Outline: Shizuku feels grateful for all of Mafuyu's help with studying and club activities, and wants to do something in return. When she learns that Mafuyu is looking for ways to improve her home ec project, she offers some embroidery lessons.

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for tutoring me today, Asahina. I was absent for this class due to work, so you really saved me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
I was also thinking about reviewing the same material, so it was a win-win for the both of us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Speaking of work, Hinomori, everyone in my class has been talking about your commercial. I was honestly staggered when I saw how beautiful you looked.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you saw it? Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But I can't rest on my laurels.
I need to make the most of my success by continuing to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. You're such a hard-working girl.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You have my support, so please feel free to ask me for help whenever you need it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She's such a kind person...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Even the other day, she agreed to do my share of the cleaning after I had to leave early...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She's been providing me with so much support.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (If only there were a way for me to thank her...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: H-Hinomori, watch out!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Eep...!
se_event_needle_2025_001

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry for yanking you so suddenly, but that pile of snow was about to fall on top of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I really appreciate it. You kept me from getting all wet.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's some snow on your shoulder, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Just give me a second to get it with my handkerchief.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, that's all of it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, your handkerchief...
The embroidery on it is beautiful. Are these camellias?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I saw one blooming in my garden, so I decided to make an embroidery of it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wait, you did this yourself?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I remember saying how beautiful that other embroidery you showed me the other day was. It's incredible how you're able to create these intricate designs.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. But it's actually not as difficult as all that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For example, these camellias use only stitches taught in home ec.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, for instance... I made the stems using back stitches, and the anthers on the stamens using French knots.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Interesting. I thought there were much more complicated stitches involved...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I saw some girls doing embroidery for their home ec projects. I might just do the same now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What project?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
You're not taking home ec this term, are you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We were recently asked to make some accessories of our choice as part of a project. That includes pen cases, pouches and such...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We can apparently score bonus points by sewing on buttons and embroidering them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. Which is why some girls are choosing to embroider theirs...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Getting to design your project however you like sounds like so much fun! What do you plan on doing for yours, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm going make a tissue box cover.
I found some instructions in the supply catalog, so I'll be following that mostly.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I still haven't decided how I'm going to decorate it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I wish I knew how to embroider like you, Hinomori. I'd have more options if I did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More options...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you like me to teach you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I know this is sudden, and I don't actually know if I'll be able to help...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you should be able to apply what I teach you to your project, which in turn should make it more fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I appreciate the offer.
But you don't have to do that. I know your work as an idol keeps you very busy...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't worry about me. I can teach you a few simple stitches during lunch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You've done so much for me in the past, Asahina. It would make me happy to know I could help you too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If you're willing to say that, then I might just have to take you up on your offer.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You will? Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we meet during lunch tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, that sounds good.
I'll be looking forward to our lesson.
A few hours later
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... I have my needles and embroidery hoops, so that just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, we're going to need some extra cloth and thread to use for practice. I should have some little pieces somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm so glad that I finally get to help Asahina.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to prepare a good lesson for her.)
<Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Len...!
Good evening.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Good evening. Sorry for dropping in on you so suddenly.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I wanted to ask you about something...
Did I come at a bad time?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, you're fine. I was just getting some things together for tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What's happening tomorrow?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I promised a friend that I'd teach her how to embroider during lunch.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I see.
That explains why you have all these sewing supplies out. And this pile of books on embroidery...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I'm reading through these again to find some good ideas for my lesson.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That includes deciding which stitches I'm going to teach my friend...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I see.
Sound like you're putting a lot of effort into this.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes... I want to repay her for what she's done for me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Repay her?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've actually been relying on this friend quite a lot...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even today, she was kind enough to fill me in on the classes that I missed. It's like she's always there to help...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But this is my chance to help her.
That's why I want to give her a proper, good lesson.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, it sounds like she means a lot to you.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Good luck, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I didn't mean to do all the talking.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You said you wanted to ask me about something, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, right. For our Valentine's Day, we're thinking about striking poses involving hearts when we talk with the audience and stuff. But I still haven't decided what I'm gonna do...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Poses involving hearts?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We're having a contest to see who strikes the best pose that involves hearts.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds like a wonderful way to celebrate Valentine's Day! You're all going to look so adorable.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, but I wanna try doing a pose that's both cute and stylish.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I've been researching expressions and gestures that make me look cool and relaxed... But I felt that I should ask you, Shizuku, since you probably know a lot about this stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. In that case, I'll be more than happy to help.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Thanks! You're the best.
The pose I have in mind right now is...>
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Alright, Hinomori, I'm ready to learn.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, I'm ready as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Today, I'll be teaching you some simple sewing techniques. We'll try a few designs once you've gotten the hang of them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sewing techniques? As in the stitches you mentioned?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, in home ec, you likely learned them as “nami-nui” and “hongaeshi-nui”, which translate into “running stitches” and “back stitches” in English.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see. You're so knowledgeable...
Like a real teacher.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you think so...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... Then, why don't we begin by trying some outline stitches.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You use them quite a lot to draw lines and fill in gaps. First, let me show you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Once you have your thread knot and poke the needle back out, you'll stick it back in a short distance away...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Next, you go back about half a step and stick the needle in at the midpoint of your previous stitch. By doing this a few times...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, it's turning into a line.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, this is how you do an outline stitch.
Compared to a back stitch, the line you create ends up being a little thicker.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Next, let's try doing it together,

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay. So, start by making a thread knot and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How does this look?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, that's excellent!
Your line is very straight.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You could try spacing your stitches more evenly to make it look cleaner, but that's just me splitting hairs.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ah, thank you. I'll give that a try.

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Hey, have you decided what you're gonna do for Valentine's Day yet?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: I have, but I'm keeping my present a secret until the day of.

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Aww... I wanted to use your idea as a springboard.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The girls in the corridor seem to be having a fun conversation.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They're already getting ready for Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll need to start thinking about that soon.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do you plan on giving a gift to someone?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, my groupmates are going to throw a Valentine's Day party, and they told me to bring something.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, with Ena and the others? That sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I also plan on giving gifts on Valentine's Day to those around me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's a wonderful opportunity for me to show my appreciation for them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They mean so much to me, so I want my gifts to them to reflect that fact.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Gifts that mean something. I like the sound of that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But what would count as that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Well... Oh, I know!
You could give them accessories that you embroidered yourself.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Embroidery, huh... Yes, a gift does tend to feel more special when you know it's handmade.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right? This is just how I feel, but I believe quite a lot of emotion goes into every stitch.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A lot of emotion...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. The process of choosing the right design for the person you have in mind, and carefully stitching it in, really allows you to channel in your emotions.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why, for those truly special occasions, I almost always give people things that I embroidered myself.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see.
It's a wonderful reflection of who you are, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, let's do our best to make gifts that our respective recipients will really enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku, there you are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, Asahina, hello.
I didn't realize you were with her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hello. Are you here for Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I need to steal her for a minute.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Did you see the message in our group chat, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What message? Give me just a second...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
I'm so sorry! My phone's battery ran out...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I had a feeling.
Anyway, please take a look at it when you get a chance. It details our activities for the near term.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you for taking the time to come to tell me, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Also, what were you two doing just now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Embroidery practice.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori agreed to teach me how to embroider after I told her that we were assigned a project for home ec.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were just working on some basic stitches, but we'll be putting them into practice in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For example, by making these flowers.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wow, they're beautiful...
You can embroider these yourself?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, these sorts of designs are perfect for accenting handkerchiefs and socks. I actually embroider these quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? Putting in your own designs like that does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This might be worth streaming...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, like an embroidery stream?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Remember how Airi streamed a cooking lesson the other day?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That got a lot of positive feedback, because it's such a useful life skill. I have a feeling that a lot of people would be interested in you teaching them how to embroider too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see your point!
The segments that allow our viewers to follow along and participate have been very popular...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I didn't mean to turn this into work talk.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I can tell that you both care very deeply about your fans.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I also think that's a good idea for a stream.
I mean, Hinomori, you're such an incredible teacher.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You think so? It's very encouraging to hear you say that, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, let's ask Airi about this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, also... Would it be possible for you to teach me how to embroider sometime too? That should help us put the plan for our stream together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Of course.
I'll make sure to set aside some time for that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In that case, Kiritani, why don't you join us now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? But...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Don't worry, we've only just begun. Oh, unless you have a prior engagement...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
What a good idea!
What do you say, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind me jumping in...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, let's practice together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, Haruka, I'll also start teaching you some basic stitches.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Ms. Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku, can you take a look at my lazy daisy stitch? Did I get it right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! Your spacing is perfect, and you also made sure not to pull too hard as you sewed. Next, let's...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, lunch is about to end...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're right. We were so focused that the time just flew by.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for teaching us all this, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know we only got to practice doing a couple stitches today, but seeing my work slowly come together was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, I know what you mean.
It's always nice to see the effort you put in bear fruit like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you both had so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: To be honest, I was hoping to get you two to embroider some flowers...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, that would be fun to do during our stream.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, since we couldn't quite finish today, why don't we meet again sometime?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's do that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...!
Why don't you try embroidering some penguins, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, you can embroider penguins?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I have a book of animal patterns at home, so I'll bring it with me next time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be looking forward to our next embroidery lesson. When should we meet next?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Well...
We could meet again in one of the classrooms during lunch...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Or this other place I really recommend.
Would you both be okay with that?
A few days later
Sewing Lounge

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew... Thank goodness we didn't get lost along the way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you for leading the way.
I'm liking this place's relaxed atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it's the perfect place for today's lesson, since they have all the things we need for embroidery available for rent.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, it's the sewing lounge. I was wondering where you were taking us, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Have you been here before, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, but Mizuki's told me all about it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, hold on... Isn't today when...?
Huh? That looks like...
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I knew it! Hi, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is usually when Mizuki comes to do alterations.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hi, Mizuki...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, Shizuku and Haruka too?!
What's going on today?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She brought us here to give us a lesson in embroidery.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, okay...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then, can I join you guys?!
Embroidered ribbons are in lately, so I really wanna learn how to make them!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
We can make some together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Then, if you don't mind me squeezing in♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's do our best today, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I can't believe that I get to learn with you and the others like this, Haruka!
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, let's begin our second embroidery lesson♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have some flowers for you to embroider, Asahina, and penguins for you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Oh, I didn't realize I'd get to choose from all these different types...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but don't worry. They all involve the same stitches I showed you the other day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What about these penguins?
This looks pretty tricky...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not to worry. You should be able to make them, since they only involve using outline stitches.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And we'll practice doing some basic stitches, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I'm ready to learn!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa! Look at you, Mafuyu!
Your flowers are so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You think so?
I think our teacher here deserves most of the credit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, it's because you're so talented.
You've only just begun learning, but everything's so well-balanced. I'm very impressed.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! What if you sewed a bead or a button in the middle? That should make it look even cuter!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
Would you mind showing me how to do that, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's finished...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow!
These penguins look so adorably chubby!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I think I've gotten the hang of doing outline stitches.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... In that case, would you like to try coloring it in using another type of stitch?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not only will you be able to make it look even cuter, you'll even be able to add a gradation using different colored threads.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, that would allow me to give the babies fluffy feathers, and the emperor penguins their characteristic yellow necks...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please show me, Shizuku.
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That should be everything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Mafuyu, you're done too?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wow, your flowers are beautiful...
I really love these blue ones with the beads in them. They're so cute and sparkly.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: These would make any accessory look really photogenic! I'm gonna give these a shot when I get home♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe we're all finished now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Nice work today, everyone.
I was honestly a little surprised by how quickly you were all able to master everything.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's because you took us through each technique step by step. I have a good feeling about my project now, thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too. I never imagined being able to embroider adorable penguins like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Same here!
Chatting with all of you while we embroidered was super fun! I hope we get to do this again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, why don't we all gather again to make our gifts for Valentine's Day?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For Valentine's Day?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I plan on embroidering a few accessories again this year, so I thought we could make some together.

Thank you so much, Haruka...! I promise to treasure this pouch and what you just said forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm glad to hear that you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Next, Airi, I'd like to present you my gift.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
I'm starting to feel kinda nervous, after all that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Here you are.
Happy Valentine's Day, Airi♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Is this a keychain...?
Oh, it's an embroidered sun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, it's so pretty! Look at all the shiny beads and threads!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're always shining so brightly and illuminating us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I thought it was just perfect for you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Your eyes are shining brightly too, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
H-Hey, cut me some slack.
Anyone would feel this way after receiving something like this...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, Shizuku...
I promise to make good use of this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're welcome...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Next, Len, would you mind?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No problem. I'll be the one presenting what we got for you and the others, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, Len, why you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Because I helped them come up with embroidery designs for their gifts.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, he provided us with some wonderful ideas after thinking very hard about all of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I had no idea...!
Now I can't wait to see what you made.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Show us already, Len♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, Rin, I'll start with you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Here you are.
Happy Valentine's Day, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Wow, this towel feels so fluffy and absorbent!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's embroidered with... My face, and some yellow flowers?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
They're canola flowers.
Shizuku did your face, and I did the flowers.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Apparently, these flowers symbolize cheerful energy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's supposed to be you making all your fans smile while putting on a fun and happy performance.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks, Len...!
And you both, Shizuku, Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm gonna use this towel to practice and put on shows that send everyone home smiling!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what kind of design did you come up for me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, MEIKO, for you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I also made pouches for you two, Airi, Shizuku. I hope you both like them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I also made keychains for you both. I'll hand them out now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, thanks so much...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that everyone's enjoying their gifts.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We put so much thought and effort into our gifts, and we get to see them all smile now...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I couldn't be happier...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(This is the power of embroidery...
It has the ability to make these sorts of connections with others.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I hope things are going well on Asahina's end...)
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The chocolates you brought are very good, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. This brand is really popular.
Also, you can only get them in this flavor for a limited time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: While you brought an assortment of different types, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I bought a bunch of individually wrapped ones and made a selection! Aren't they cute?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. You really put a lot of effort into these wrappings too. Oh, all these ribbons have different designs.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, Ena, thanks for noticing!
I actually embroidered all of those.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Embroidered? Does that mean you made all these little pictures with thread...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I did! Not only that, they all have pins on the back so that you can use them as brooches!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, Rin, but I need to borrow you for a second. By scrunching together a bit of fabric like this, you can keep the pinhole in your clothes mostly hidden...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, Mizuki, I can do this myself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Sorry!
I really want you guys to try them on, since I chose designs that I thought would suit each of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't realize you could make anything like this, Mizuki. I'm really impressed...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks! But the party's just getting started!
Right, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, Mafuyu, you also brought something?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, I did.
But they're not chocolates.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Here, this is for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... A handkerchief?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I wasn't expecting that.
It also appears to be embroidered.
Could it be...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I embroidered it myself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We made these while Shizuku taught us.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, these are really well-made...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did you embroider these on canvas?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aren't they amazing?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why are you acting so proud, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But still... It's not just the fact that you used canvas. You designed a nice scene, and these flowers are so intricate but done so well...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, this is really good...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is it? That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What's the design on yours, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... This looks like... A candle?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
The flame's really pretty...
What made you choose this design?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...
I'm not exactly sure myself...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I thought this was the right design for you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mafuyu...
This is a wonderful gift.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Somehow, I feel warm...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I also have one for you, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, you made one for me?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I felt that I should.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe! Thanks! Let's take a look-see♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, you embroidered a cat!
It's so cute...! I promise to take good care of it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...
Did you make some for us?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. But MEIKO and KAITO aren't here, so please give these to them later when you see them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why wouldn't I be?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You worked very hard on these handkerchiefs, Mafuyu, so I think we all feel that you should give these to them yourself.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, why don't we go find them right now?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What?! But they could be anywhere.
Finding them might take forever.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But it'll be good exercise!
Working up a sweat should make our chocolates taste even better, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, let's go!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, wait!
I said wait, come on...!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Let's go, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...
se_walk_women_001_4
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Asahina...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, Hinomori, hello.
Are you on your way home?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Would you like to walk together?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sure. I'm glad that we ran into each other.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Me too.
I've actually been hoping to talk to you, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh? Did you need me for something?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Not quite...
I just wanted to ask how things went when you gave your gifts during Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see.
The others were very surprised when they found out that I made embroideries for them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I have you and the others to thank, Hinomori. They really enjoyed the designs we came up with together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They did? Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. So, Hinomori, thank you again for teaching me how to embroider.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was able to give everyone some wonderful presents as a result, and I got a taste of the joy of embroidery...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're very welcome! I'm so glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If possible, I'd like to embroider with you again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, also... This doesn't really make up for what you did for me, but I embroidered a handkerchief for you, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
I embroidered one for you as well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You did? Hehe. We read each other's minds.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know. Why don't we open these on three?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay. One, two...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Mafuyu
rows.Line: Three.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, did you...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, Asahina, you also embroidered a snow rabbit...?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What are the odds that we'd both embroider the same thing?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Astronomical.
I decided to embroider a snow rabbit after I remembered how we made some together here a little while back...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't believe that you remembered, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I mean, those snow rabbits were just so cute.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Hinomori...
I promise to treasure this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'll do the same with your gift.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I invited her to embroider with me...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Her friends seem to have enjoyed what she made for them, and I was able to help her for a change...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Asahina said she saw the joy of embroidery...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(In that sense...
I feel like we've become closer friends.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (If Asahina was able to enjoy even just a fraction of the time she spent embroidering...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Then I couldn't be happier.)
